Real photos, real payouts

From camera roll to cash

  1. 1Score it freeUpload any photo. It’s scored out of 100 in seconds, and your first score wins you gems.
  2. 2Get it to 80Spend gems on fixes, three versions each time. Most photos take 3 to 5 fixes. At 80 it can enter competitions, and every photo that competes hangs in your gallery.
  3. 3Enter and get judgedReal people score every entry category by category. The top photos split the prize pool.
  4. 4Earn while you waitJudge other people’s photos to earn gems, and battle challengers to take theirs.

Prototype build. Prize pools and winners shown are illustrative. Gems have no cash value, and store purchases here are simulated.
